description: Distance profile of the TxGH116 N-terminal domain to the catalytic pair: which N-terminal segments line the active-site mouth, and whether they are lost or retained in CG33090-PC
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
m=json.load(open("out/mind.json"))["mind"]
d={int(k):v for k,v in m.items()} if isinstance(m,dict) else {r:v for r,v in m}
res=np.array(sorted(d)); dist=np.array([d[r] for r in res])
print("residues with a distance value:", len(res), res.min(), res.max())

ntd = (res>=31)&(res<=410)          # N-terminal beta-sandwich in 5BVU numbering
lost= (res>=31)&(res<=117)          # lost in PC
kept= (res>=118)&(res<=410)         # retained N-terminal part
for nm,msk in [("N-terminal domain 31-410",ntd),("lost 31-117",lost),("retained 118-410",kept)]:
    sub=dist[msk]
    print(f"  {nm:26s} n={msk.sum():4d}  min={sub.min():6.2f} A  residues <8 A: "
          f"{[int(r) for r,x in zip(res[msk],sub) if x<8]}")
near = [(int(r),round(float(x),2)) for r,x in zip(res[kept],dist[kept]) if x<10]
print("\nretained N-terminal residues within 10 A of the catalytic pair:", near)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.6))
ax.plot(res,dist,lw=0.8,color="#34495e")
ax.axhspan(0,8,color="#f5d5d0",zorder=0)
ax.axvspan(31,117,color="#f2c4c0",alpha=0.6,zorder=0,label="lost in CG33090-PC (31-117)")
ax.axvspan(118,410,color="#d6e4f0",alpha=0.6,zorder=0,label="retained N-terminal sandwich (118-410)")
ax.axvspan(416,801,color="#e8f0e2",alpha=0.6,zorder=0,label="catalytic (alpha/alpha)6 (416-801)")
ax.set_xlabel("TxGH116 residue (PDB 5BVU, author numbering)")
ax.set_ylabel("min heavy-atom distance\nto E441/D593 carboxylates, A")
ax.set_ylim(0,60); ax.set_xlim(res.min(),res.max())
ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="upper right")
ax.set_title("Only the retained part of the N-terminal sandwich reaches the active site")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
